capabilities: insert exercise blocks into notes using code block syntax
create dropdown select and multiple choice questions with marked correct options
add text input and line answers with one or more accepted values
build matching exercises pairing values from two columns
randomize options before display and evaluate answers on reveal
motivation: Developed as an easy way to create exercises within Obsidian for exam prep, language learning, and memory refreshers alongside notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to embed self-test exercises that can be answered and checked directly inside a note.
summary: Exercise plugin that renders interactive quizzes (dropdowns, text inputs, matching, multiple choice) inside notes via code block syntax.
